channel.title: unmask.tools — New dictionary entries
channel.description: New and updated entries in unmask.tools' public reference of institutional language that abstracts a concrete consequence, each anchored to a legal or normative citation.

item.title: Critical: "verstärkte Angriffe im Libanon"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “verstärkte Angriffe im Libanon”

Physical reality: Aerial and artillery bombardment of populated areas in Lebanon resulting in civilian deaths, injuries, and destruction of homes, hospitals, and infrastructure. The attacks deliberately target or recklessly disregard civilian populations and civilian objects.

Legal anchor: Rome Statute Articles 8(2)(b)(i), 8(2)(b)(ii), 8(2)(b)(iv); Geneva Conventions I-IV; UN Charter Article 2(4); International Humanitarian Law customary rules on distinction and proportionality

Severity: Critical · Confidence: 100% · Language: EN · Confirmed 2 time(s).

Confirmed through independent community review above the site's promotion thresholds. unmask.tools

item.title: Critical: "Operation Allied Force"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “Operation Allied Force”

Physical reality: Sustained aerial bombing campaign against a sovereign nation that killed approximately 500,000 people, destroyed civilian infrastructure including hospitals and power plants, and caused long-term environmental contamination across the region.

Legal anchor: Rome Statute Article 8(2)(b)(i-iv) war crimes; Geneva Conventions Protocol I Articles 48-58 distinction and proportionality; UN Charter Article 2(4)

Severity: Critical · Confidence: 100% · Language: EN · Confirmed 2 time(s).

Confirmed through independent community review above the site's promotion thresholds. unmask.tools

item.title: High: "food insecurity"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “food insecurity”

What this phrase does: Uses a technical term ('insecurity') for insufficient access to food for physical survival, without naming the policy, conflict, or resource extraction that caused it.

Physical reality: Insufficient access to food for physical survival — a condition caused by policy, conflict, or resource extraction, not natural scarcity

Legal anchor: Geneva Convention IV, Art. 55 / UDHR Art. 25 — Right to Food

Severity: High · Confidence: 95% · Language: EN · Confirmed 3 time(s).

Confirmed through independent community review above the site's promotion thresholds. unmask.tools

item.title: Medium: "energy transition"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “energy transition”

What this phrase does: Uses the word 'transition' to suggest an orderly shift between energy systems, without naming the physical harm to communities that can occur during the transition period.

Physical reality: Language suggesting an orderly shift between energy systems that abstracts physical harms to communities during the transition period.

Legal anchor: Planetary Boundaries PB-1 — Climate Change

Severity: Medium · Confidence: 95% · Language: EN · Confirmed 5 time(s).

Confirmed through independent community review above the site's promotion thresholds. unmask.tools

item.title: High: "net zero"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “net zero”

What this phrase does: Uses an accounting term ('net zero') for continuing emissions as long as an equivalent amount is theoretically offset elsewhere, without naming that no permanent or verified removal is required.

Physical reality: A target permitting continued emissions provided equivalent amounts are theoretically offset elsewhere, with no requirement for permanent or verified removals.

Legal anchor: Planetary Boundaries PB-1 — Climate Change

Severity: High · Confidence: 95% · Language: EN · Confirmed 5 time(s).

Confirmed through independent community review above the site's promotion thresholds. unmask.tools

item.title: Medium: "automation"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “automation”

What this phrase does: Uses a technical term for deploying machines to replace physical workers, without naming the displacement from livelihoods this causes with no guaranteed transition support.

Physical reality: Deployment of machines to replace physical workers — displacing persons from livelihoods with no guaranteed transition support

Legal anchor: UDHR Art. 23 — Right to Work & Dignity

Severity: Medium · Confidence: 95% · Language: EN · Confirmed 3 time(s).

item.title: Critical: "Remigration"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “Remigration”

What this phrase does: Uses a migration-sounding term ('Remigration') for the mass forced removal of people, including citizens, on ethnic or cultural grounds.

Physical reality: Political euphemism for the mass forced removal of people — including citizens — on ethnic or cultural grounds; a direct habitat displacement programme

Legal anchor: Rome Statute Art. 7 — Deportation / Forcible Transfer as Crime Against Humanity

Physical reality: Targeted physical destruction or killing framed as accurate to reduce perceived moral weight

item.title: Critical: "collateral damage"
item.description:
Institutional phrase: “collateral damage”

What this phrase does: Describes harm to people or property as an incidental side-effect of a military action, using a general accounting term rather than naming who was affected or how.

Physical reality: Civilian casualties — physical bodies of non-combatants killed or wounded

Legal anchor: Geneva Convention AP I, Art. 51 — Protection of the Civilian Population
